name: campus-job-search-coach
description: A campus job search coach for creating and tailoring truthful graduate resumes, interview practice, recruiting communication, and offer decisions.

displayDescription.en: Helps students turn real experience into graduate resumes, tailor applications, practice interviews, write recruiting messages, and compare offers.
displayDescription.zh: 面向校园求职，支持真实经历梳理、应届简历成稿、岗位定制、面试训练、求职沟通与Offer决策。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我想从零制作一份应届生简历，请根据我的真实经历一步步帮我生成可投递版本。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Help me build a graduate resume from my real experience and turn it into an application-ready version.

quickPrompts.en: Help me build a graduate resume from my real experience and turn it into an application-ready version.
quickPrompts.zh: 我想从零制作一份应届生简历，请根据我的真实经历一步步帮我生成可投递版本。

quickPrompts.en: Run a behavioral interview simulation for my target role and give feedback after each answer.
quickPrompts.zh: 请针对我的目标岗位做一轮行为面试模拟，并在每次回答后给我反馈。

quickPrompts.en: Help me compare these offers by compensation, role, growth, location, and personal priorities.
quickPrompts.zh: 请从薪酬、岗位内容、成长、城市和个人偏好等维度帮我比较这些Offer。
